title: Landscaper
industry: Construction, Building and Architecture, Property and Real Estate
description:
Summary
The Landscaper will be responsible for the maintenance and enhancement of the grounds and outdoor spaces of our residential and commercial properties. This role involves a variety of tasks including planting, trimming, mowing, and general landscape upkeep. The ideal candidate will have a strong knowledge of horticulture, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for outdoor work.
Duties and Responsibilities
Landscaping Maintenance:
Perform routine lawn care tasks such as mowing, edging, weeding, and trimming.
Plant and maintain flowers, shrubs, trees, and other greenery.
Apply fertilizers, pesticides, and other treatments to maintain healthy landscapes.
Prune and trim trees and shrubs to maintain shape and remove damaged or diseased branches.
Groundskeeping:
Maintain cleanliness and appearance of outdoor areas, including picking up trash and debris.
Ensure walkways, driveways, and outdoor structures are clear and well-maintained.
Inspect irrigation systems and perform minor repairs as needed.
Assist with the installation and maintenance of outdoor features such as lighting, benches, and decorative elements.
Equipment Operation and Maintenance:
Operate and maintain landscaping equipment, including mowers, trimmers, blowers, and other tools.
Perform routine maintenance and minor repairs on equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Seasonal Tasks:
Perform seasonal landscaping tasks such as leaf removal, snow removal, and winterizing plants and irrigation systems.
Assist with special projects and events as needed, including holiday decorations and property beautification efforts.
Job Requirements
Experience:
Proven experience in landscaping, groundskeeping, or a related field.
Knowledge:
Strong understanding of horticulture principles and landscape maintenance techniques.
Skills:
Proficiency with landscaping tools and equipment. Basic mechanical skills for equipment maintenance.
Physical Requirements:
Ability to perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting, bending, and working in various weather conditions.
Communication Skills:
Good communication skills and ability to follow instructions and work as part of a team.
Attention to Detail:
High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards of work.
Driver's License:
Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
